_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Level scrubber shows numbers only; larger chosen level and example words
detail: The scrubber no longer repeats the word 'Level': it shows 1 2 3 4 5…, with the chosen number large and the rest tapering away. 'Level N' stays in the readout above (and as each slot's accessible name).
Readout 'Level N' 16 to 18px; frequency line, 'e.g.' words and coverage figure up to 14/13px.

entries.summary: Level scrubber taper now works on both sides
detail: Levels you have passed were pinned to a flat 62% opacity and hid the taper; now every level shrinks and fades with its distance from the chosen one (about 120%, 90%, 60% size; 68%, 36%, 15% opacity).

entries.summary: Source choice: summary, then two matching option cards; commonness meter forced to one ink
detail: Everyday speech and Your music are now twin cards: icon and name, description, then a ruled 'Best for' line. On desktop the cards are equal height with the rules aligned.
The summary sits above a thin divider; Connect your Spotify sits under Your music.
The commonness meter's colour is now forced to the text colour (!important) in both themes, in case a light-theme rule was still tinting it.

entries.summary: Main page clear-up: spacing, tighter top bar, set colours as legend, tapering levels
detail: More space between Choose level, Choose a set and Practice errors (a little less on phones).
Top bar is tighter with a thinner coloured ring.
Choose a set: the Known/Practice/New legend is gone; each count under the set numbers carries its own coloured swatch.
Level scrubber: the chosen level is biggest and each level away shrinks and fades.
The '~46.3% of speech' figure moved to the bottom right of the level box, under the example words.

entries.summary: Smart Skip desktop: larger text; no extra Bigger-text zoom; no '=' in preview
detail: On wide screens the Smart Skip page uses larger type and taller rows by default.
The Bigger text setting no longer zooms the Smart Skip page on desktop (it still applies elsewhere and on phones).
The word preview popup no longer shows '=' before a look-alike's English.

entries.summary: Smart Skip table: dropped the '=' before obvious look-alikes
detail: The flag column headers already say the second column is the English word.

entries.summary: Smart Skip: two channels on desktop; clearer look-alike and combined-forms wording
detail: Wide screens: settings in a left column that stays put, the word list on the right. Phones keep one column.
Look-alikes now read 'Words that look similar and mean the same in English'.
Combined forms notes that forms with a meaning of their own (fue, al) keep their own card.

entries.summary: Combined forms: tap a row to see every form; '+N' instead of '…'
detail: The forms column shows three forms and '+N' for the rest.
Tapping a combined-forms row opens it in place with every form as a chip and a 'Preview card' link.
Other categories still open the preview popup.

entries.summary: Smart Skip list gets column headers; Rank and Type on desktop only
detail: Header row: language flags name the word and English columns; Rank on desktop; Type under 'All skipped'.
Combined forms: Card | English | Combined forms | Rank on desktop; on phones just the card, English and a forms count.
On phones the Rank and Type columns are hidden.

entries.summary: Smart Skip list: levels replaced by each word's frequency rank
detail: The 'Level N' bands are gone; the list is one run of rows in frequency order.
Each row ends in its rank, a narrow right-aligned number. On phones the category tag is hidden to make room.
The word preview no longer names a level.

entries.summary: Smart Skip list: level headers no longer show a word count
detail: Each level divider now reads just 'Level N'.

entries.summary: Smart Skip: tighter vertical spacing, label beside the menu, look-alikes open first
detail: Smaller gap between the Smart Skip title and the first box, and between the boxes and the word list.
'Skipped words' now sits on the same line as its dropdown, in the dropdown's font.
Dropdown entries are all 'Name (count)'; 'Combined forms' no longer says 'cards'.
The dropdown opens on Look-alikes whenever there are any.

entries.summary: Landing page: near-black boxes on a lifted page; lighter language colours
detail: Dark theme: setup boxes are near-black (#06090d) on a slightly lifted page (#151c25) so text stands out.
Language colours are lifted further against the dark page (contrast target 4 to 5.5), so Portugal's green and similar deep flag colours read lighter.

entries.summary: Smart Skip page tidied; advanced switches moved into their own sheet; landing page spacing evened out
detail: Smart Skip title is centred, level with the close button, with no dark bar or gap above it.
Pronouns & particles, slang & fillers and names & places now live behind a quiet 'Advanced options' row that opens a sheet marked optional.
The word list is headed 'Skipped words'; the search box and 'Study these' button are gone.
Combined-forms example now reads 'share one flashcard'.
Choose level / Choose a set / Practice errors: equal space above and below each title and a smaller gap between boxes.

entries.summary: Look-alikes skip again in Portuguese, Spanish and Czech; commonness labels open on hover; Quick 20 label
detail: Cognate files rebound to the releases the app loads (pt/es v23, cs v22); they named v21, so Smart Skip found 0 look-alikes. A test now fails if they drift apart.
The 'N rarer senses' row no longer shows a meter (their pooled share could read as Dominant).
Commonness meters show their meaning on hover; the section-head label no longer opens outside the card.
When every row in an open section has its own meter, the section head drops its total.
Practice errors button always reads 'Quick N' with the number (20 at most).

entries.summary: Remove the '+N' chip on folded senses
detail: Folded senses no longer show a '+N' chip; tapping a folded sense makes it the current one, which shows its sub-rows
The current sense never folds

entries.summary: Commonness meter lives in the top sense row (the section head), open or folded
detail: Each part-of-speech section head shows its sense's commonness whether open or folded
A section with one sense shows it only there; its row no longer repeats it
Sections with several senses keep a meter on each sense, since they can differ

entries.summary: Rarer uses as one compact list; clearer OR on the source choice; one meter colour; grouped-sense meter level with the sense line
detail: Rarer uses lists every sense at once with examples folded behind 'Examples · N'; the × / ✓ marks are gone
The OR between Everyday speech and Your music is a round badge on a stronger rule, on phones and wide screens
Light mode: the commonness meter is one ink colour at every level, as in dark mode
A grouped sense's meter is back at the row's right edge, level with the sense line (top when the gloss stacks above its sub-rows); a folded group with per-sub-row meters shows one total

entries.summary: Shorten the tutorial card on desktop and mobile
detail: Reduced card padding, context padding and desktop spacing between card sections.
Lowered the minimum tutorial card height.
Mobile leaves extra space above its tutorial controls.

entries.summary: 'Quick 20' button in Practice amber; fuller Practice errors info; index manifest retries after a failed fetch
detail: The setup screen's quick practice button reads 'Quick 20', larger, in the amber of the Practice legend rather than error red
The Practice errors info sheet explains what collects there and the order Quick practice takes: Never correct, Needs attention, Due now

A failed request for a release's index manifest is retried once and not remembered, so one network blip no longer leaves every set load on a missing vocabulary.index.json until reload; a release with no manifest (404) is still remembered

entries.summary: Make tutorial explanations easier to read and match real card context styling
detail: Removed the purple tr. badge and the instruction to click the meaning heading.
Example contexts use the real card’s shaded cue areas.
Desktop explanation titles, body text, Back/Next buttons and progress count are larger and brighter.

entries.summary: Reflexive split words put each sense on its own card; 'Flashcard 1 of 2' sits beside stacked pills
detail: Senses go to the card their split assigned them (by sense id); 'pongan' no longer shows ponerse's senses and examples on poner's card
'Flashcard 1 of 2' runs under side-by-side pills, and moves to their right, centred on the pair, when the pills stack

entries.summary: Start the tutorial directly on the selected mode’s card
detail: Removed the animated language, mode, level and set selection opening.
First-run onboarding waits until Speech or Lyrics is chosen.
Speech teaches one card; Spanish Lyrics reuses the same tour with song line count, song credit, English translation and playback explanations.

entries.summary: Housekeeping: removed unused backup-sentence loading code from the card script; the changelog now keeps the latest 30 entries.
detail: Removed the never-called backup example loader from flashcards.js (no visible change).
Trimmed this changelog to the newest 30 entries; older ones stay in git history.
Deploy merges now keep at most 30 entries, so trimmed entries cannot return.

entries.summary: Main menu tidy: even header spacing, 'Practice errors' section, no app name in copy
detail: Less space above Choose level and Choose a set, so each title sits evenly between the box above and its own box
Choose a set no longer says 'Level 1 · 1/4 sets studied'; the set buttons already show it

Practice is now a 'Practice errors' section with the same header and info button as the others ('Words you have not got right come first.'); it reads 'N cards ready to practise' and 'Quick practice (20)', with no explainer text
The Practice sheet drops its top block and holds spaced repetition and the three practice groups; 'Not right yet' is now 'Never correct' and 'very late' is 'long overdue another review'
'Fluency' is replaced with 'this app' (or reworded) in visible text across the app; the Spotify player's device name is unchanged

entries.summary: Use a richer Portuguese tutorial card and make practice instructions explicit
detail: Replace banco with provar: prove, taste and try on, with 14 curated release examples
Keep the dominant meaning first and preserve verified IMDb and Tatoeba sources
Replace button-like Try it labels with instructions naming the card control to click or tap
Highlight the whole example sentence when explaining example cycling
Reveal closed meaning groups when the next explanation needs their rows and fit mobile cards to the instruction sheet

entries.summary: Search and word links open a split word as Flashcard 1 of 2, then 2 of 2
detail: Search, word links, lyric-breakdown taps and homograph peeks used to open a split word (vamos, hay) as one combined card; they now open Flashcard 1 of 2
Moving on from it (swipe, flag or next) shows Flashcard 2 of 2 in the same place before returning; the Back-to button still leaves at once
When search focuses a particular meaning, the card that holds it opens first
Split cards are built by one shared function (buildSplitCardPair) for sets and single-word views alike

entries.summary: Remove the incorrect entity-style icon beside banco in the tutorial
detail: Remove the dictionary icon added beside the Portuguese tutorial headword
Remove its extra explanation and unused header styling
Keep the verified example-source labels below the example sentence

entries.summary: Explain part of speech and dictionary form separately in the tutorial
detail: Give the part-of-speech label and dictionary form their own explanation boxes
Highlight each part of the front-card pill separately while stepping through the tutorial

entries.summary: Commonness is the share of the senses shown; grouped senses carry one meter under the gloss; 'N rarer senses' row
detail: Commonness labels and percentages are read against the senses a learner can see: expressions (their own card) leave the base, rarer senses stay in it
Split cards read their shares against their own reading, not the sibling card's senses
A grouped sense whose sub-rows share one commonness shows its meter under the gloss; the side column goes and sub-rows get the width
A lone sense that is not Dominant gets an 'N rarer senses' row with their combined commonness; it opens Rarer uses
